options.label: Backfill (Ops)
options.description: One-time asset-price backfill to fill the 1-3 month prod gap. Has a full read-only measure → catch-up → verify runbook against the dstrader prod stack.

options.label: Root cause (Bug)
options.description: Daily DSTrader run not firing in prod — cron/TWS-login investigation in the dstrader-aws repo. The reason the gap appeared.

options.label: Self-heal window
options.description: Enhancement: bump GAP_DETECT_DAYS from 30 to ~45-60 in asset_report.sh so short missed windows auto-recover.

options.label: Alerting
options.description: Enhancement: add a heartbeat/alert when daily_run.sh doesn't fire or backfill leaves missing_count > 0, so a stalled pipeline is caught in a day.
